reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues were identified for the OpenRouter parallel-tool-call handling change. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR fixes OpenRouter chat completions silently dropping `parallel_tool_calls=False`, aligning request handling with sibling integrations. **Changes:** - Forward `parallel_tool_calls=False` when specified through `tool_choice`, while leaving the default `True` unsent. - Add a mocked, parametrized regression test covering both values without network calls or API credentials. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `tests/​functions/​test_openrouter.py` | Adds regression coverage for forwarding or omitting the parallel-tool-call flag. | | `pixeltable/​functions/​openrouter.py` | Includes an explicit `parallel_tool_calls=False` in request arguments. |
Review effort: Balanced

## Claude review

Reviewed 12c8e3ea6fd97ca989395115224a7375afc16e80..32ae48a41cfcf6f188d66c113f95ace2bcdd5e37.

The problem is established: on base, `chat_completions()` never reads `tool_choice['parallel_tool_calls']`. The 2-line fix matches `openai.py` and `groq.py` exactly, so the approach is justified.

No supported findings.

### Maintenance suggestions

- The live test does not exercise `tool_choice`. [`test_tool_invocations`](https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/blob/32ae48a41cfcf6f188d66c113f95ace2bcdd5e37/tests/functions/test_openrouter.py#L68-L70) calls `run_tool_invocations_test(make_table)` with the default `test_tool_choice=False`. As a result, it never sends `tools.choice(required=True, parallel_tool_calls=False)` ([tool_utils.py](https://github.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/blob/32ae48a41cfcf6f188d66c113f95ace2bcdd5e37/tests/functions/tool_utils.py#L17-L23)). The OpenAI and Anthropic tests pass `test_tool_choice=True`. Do the same here to confirm that OpenRouter accepts the flag. The mocked test cannot show that.
Thanks for your pr. The product change looks good, one comment on the test.

review_comments.body:
We typically don't write tests with mocks, please drop it.

Instead, try to add coverage to `TestOpenRouter.test_tool_invocations` by calling `run_tool_invocations_test` with  `test_tool_choice=True`, similarly to `TestOpenai.test_responses_tool_invocations`. However that sometimes can be tricky to get to pass if the model doesn't do what `run_tool_invocations_test` expects it to. For that reason, `TestOpenai.test_responses_tool_invocations` and other similar tests have a very generous retry policy. If you can't get it to pass, that's fine, this can go in without test coverage.

comments.body:
Done: I dropped the mocked test and the parallel tool call coverage now goes through `TestOpenRouter.test_tool_invocations` with `test_tool_choice=True`, using the same generous rerun settings as `TestOpenai`. I could not run that live test locally because there is no OpenRouter key available here, so it is untested against the real API; the file parses and the diff is limited to the test.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
